testCases.title: Verify that the contact API rejects a sender name over the maximum length
preconditions: The contact endpoint POST /messages is reachable without authentication

steps.action: Send a contact message whose name is 121 characters long
steps.expected: HTTP 422; the validation error names the name field

testCases.title: Verify that the contact API accepts a sender name of exactly the maximum length
preconditions: The contact endpoint POST /messages is reachable without authentication

steps.action: Send a contact message whose name is exactly 120 characters long
steps.expected: The message is accepted and the response echoes the name with status NEW

testCases.title: Verify that the contact API enforces the email and subject length limits
preconditions: The contact endpoint POST /messages is reachable without authentication

steps.action: Send a contact message with an email address of 257 characters
steps.expected: HTTP 422; the validation error names the email field

steps.action: Send a contact message with an email address of exactly 256 characters
steps.expected: The message is accepted and the response echoes the email

steps.action: Send a contact message with a subject of 121 characters
steps.expected: HTTP 422; the validation error names the subject field

steps.action: Send a contact message with a subject of exactly 120 characters
steps.expected: The message is accepted and the response echoes the subject
